jei.jaymospowers.pull_apart.how: Click the iron pick beside your inventory, then click it to pull one apart (Shift-click for the whole stack). Or Ctrl + right-click it.
jei.jaymospowers.pull_apart.back: The crafting grid puts the parts back together.
button.jaymospowers.pull_apart.hover: Deconstruct mode: click to pull things apart into their parts (wool into string, cobblestone into rocks...).
button.jaymospowers.pull_apart.hover_on: Deconstruct mode is on. Click to turn it off.
button.jaymospowers.pull_apart.on.title: Deconstruct mode
button.jaymospowers.pull_apart.on: What can come apart is outlined in gold. Click one to pull it apart, or Shift-click to pull apart the whole stack. The crafting grid puts the parts back together. Click the pick again to stop.
